issues.reason: The proposed remedy is barred — "a control verb with a to-infinitive never seals — sealing is finite-clause-only", and this gerund is non-finite — while the complement's atoms cannot go outside the rule either ("never as a free-variable atom outside the rule", the event term being (sk_yell $x)); a strength-0 (And …) denies the bundle, exactly as the negated-event pattern does, and does not assert each conjunct false.

gaps_confirmed: gerundive (-ing) complements of psych/attitude verbs have no routing (finite that-clause, control to-infinitive and perception eventive complement are each specified, an -ing complement is not)
an agentless passive gerund as complement ("being yelled at") — the passive rule is written for finite/main clauses
a non-finite, occurrence-neutral complement inside a strength-0.0 generic rule has no polarity-neutral home: it can neither be sealed (finite-only) nor sit outside the rule (free-variable bar)
new_gaps: pronominal quantifiers ("no one", "everyone"): the kind for the rule's range and the word to record in the QuantifierPhrase companion are not specified
notes: The negated-generic rule at 0.0/0.9 with its "no" companion, Experiencer/Stimulus for stative "like", and the prepositional-verb oblique (At …) are all licensed; the reviewer identifies a real tension but mistakes the coverage gap for a defect.
